units.source_text: 悲伤也要有个限度，终于只得按照丧礼，举行火葬。

en.t: Even grief had to have its limit, and at last they could only follow the funeral rites and hold the cremation.

units.source_text: 太君恋恋不舍，哭泣哀号：“让我跟女儿一同化作灰尘吧！”

en.t: The grand lady could not bear to part from her, and cried out in tears, "Let me turn to ashes together with my daughter!"

units.source_text: 她挤上前去，乘了送葬的众侍女的车子，

en.t: She pushed her way forward and got into the carriage of the ladies-in-waiting who were accompanying the funeral,

units.source_text: 一同来到爱宕的火葬场，那里正在举行庄严的仪式呢。

en.t: and went with them to the cremation ground at Atago, where the solemn rites were being performed.

units.source_text: 太君到达其地，心情何等悲伤！

en.t: When the grand lady reached that place, how sorrowful her heart was!

units.source_text: 她说得还算通情达理：“眼看着遗骸，

en.t: What she said was still fairly reasonable: "When I see the remains before my eyes,

units.source_text: 总当她还是活着的，不肯相信她死了；

en.t: I keep thinking she is still alive, and cannot bring myself to believe that she has died;

units.source_text: 直到看见她变成了灰烬，方才确信她不是这世间的人了。”

en.t: only after seeing her turn to ashes will I be certain that she no longer belongs to this world."

units.source_text: 然而哭得几乎从车子上掉下来。

en.t: Yet she wept so hard that she nearly fell from the carriage.

units.source_text: 众侍女忙来扶持，百般劝解，

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting hurried over to support her and tried every way to console her,

units.source_text: 她们说：“早就担心会弄到这地步的。”

en.t: saying, "We were worried from the beginning that it would come to this."
